### Bible Pathways 05/15/2002
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-05-or-15-or-2002-1133432.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 11:2
Points:
- Years of adversity and exile passed between David's youth and his eventual coronation over Israel.
- Facing Saul's relentless pursuit, David wrestled with discouragement and wondered how God's word could be fulfilled.
- In God's perfect timing, the obstacles were cleared and all the tribes acknowledged his God-given leadership.
- Christians encountering difficult or seemingly impossible circumstances can trust that God faithfully directs their steps.
- David's anointing as shepherd and king anticipates Jesus Christ as the supreme Ruler.
